installing: Getting FigCraft ready on the server…
notInstalled: FigCraft isn't installed on this server yet, so only the design's picture shows here.
notInstalledFailed: The server couldn't install FigCraft, so only the design's picture shows here. Check its internet connection and restart Greenlit.
cannotRun: FigCraft can't run in this browser (it needs WebGPU or WebGL2). This is the design's picture; download the file to open it in FigCraft.
couldNotRead: The design file couldn't be read from Greenlit
viewHint: The design alone: drag to move around, pinch or ⌘-scroll to zoom
saved: Saved as a new file version
saveFailed: The design couldn't be saved to Greenlit. Your changes are still open here: save again.
cannotSave: You can look at this design but not save changes to it
cannotSaveHint: Ask an admin for upload rights to save designs.
leaveBody: The changes made in FigCraft since the last save will be lost.
newer: Someone saved a newer version of this file.
newerDirty: Someone saved a newer version of this file. Reloading discards your unsaved changes.
missingFonts_one: {{families}} isn't in FigCraft or Greenlit, so its text shows in a stand-in font.
missingFonts_other: {{families}} aren't in FigCraft or Greenlit, so their text shows in a stand-in font.
askAdmin: An admin can add it in Settings
addFailed: The file couldn't be added to the library

section.title: Design
section.clickHint: Click a frame to see it once FigCraft is open.

fonts.title: Design fonts
fonts.description: FigCraft has the common open fonts built in. Add the other fonts your designs use, such as your brand's, so they show in Greenlit with the right type.
fonts.descriptionRenderer: FigCraft has the common open fonts built in. Add the other fonts your designs use, such as your brand's, so they show in Greenlit with the right type and their pictures are rendered with it.
fonts.emptyBody: Add .ttf or .otf files. Designs that use them show with them the next time they open.
fonts.removeBody: Designs that use it will show its text in a stand-in font.
